fusions.name: Reef Rasp
fusions.desc: A rasping bite that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Polyp Scour
fusions.desc: You roll against every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 12 damage and making each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Calcified Crust
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 22% and your water resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Grown in Place
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once into a shield worth 4% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour is 4% higher at all times.
